Total revenue for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2024 increased 10% to $1.5 billion compared with $1.4 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2023. Constant currency organic revenue from continuing operations for the fourth quarter increased 7% to $1.4 billion compared with $1.3 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2023.
